description: This file defines the NotesDatabase class, an abstract Room database setup for managing notes within an Android application. It includes the singleton pattern for database instance management and references the Note entity and NoteDao.

classes.name: NotesDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class extending RoomDatabase that provides an instance of NoteDao and implements singleton pattern for database access.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe singleton instance of the NotesDatabase, initializing it if necessary.
